gaps.title: Follower-only profiles have no follow-request approval flow
gaps.productionImpact: Any authenticated follower can create the follow row immediately; follower-only visibility therefore has no owner approval boundary.
gaps.recommendedFix: Add pending/accept/reject follow requests and make follower-only authorization depend on accepted state.
gaps.verification: Cross-user acceptance must prove an unapproved account cannot view follower-only data.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-api/tests/api-baseline-02.security-acceptance.test.ts#requires explicit approval before a follower-only profile becomes visible

gaps.title: All published releases are unsigned and unsigned releases are still trusted
gaps.productionImpact: Cryptographic Ed25519 verification exists, but 12 of 12 published releases have no signature and policy calls them verified.
gaps.recommendedFix: Require a verified publisher signature for production publication/install, with an explicit controlled legacy migration.
gaps.verification: A tampered/unsigned test release must be rejected; current releases must return signature.state=verified.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-api/tests/registry-trust.trust-block.test.ts#exposes an unsigned published release as untrusted and refuses install preview

gaps.title: Only 2 of 14 registry releases have retrievable package bytes
gaps.productionImpact: Published metadata can exist without an artifact ref, preventing independent package retrieval/verification for most releases.
gaps.recommendedFix: Backfill immutable package blobs and block publication/installability when the package is absent.
gaps.verification: Every published installable release must pass a digest-matched artifact GET.

gaps.title: Seven of seventeen module presentation assets have metadata but no blob
gaps.productionImpact: Product Hub receives declared URLs whose asset route returns 404 for affected releases.
gaps.recommendedFix: Require asset blob presence during ingestion/publication and backfill or remove broken metadata.
gaps.verification: Catalogue crawl must retrieve and digest-check every advertised available asset.

gaps.title: Runtime auto-grants manifest permissions when no review row exists
gaps.productionImpact: Two active production installations have no review; their declared permissions become effective without recorded user grant.
gaps.recommendedFix: Remove the fallback for production, backfill explicit reviews, and fail closed when grant evidence is absent.
gaps.verification: All active installations must have a review and missing-review requests must return FORBIDDEN.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-api/tests/api-baseline-02.security-acceptance.test.ts#fails closed when a module permission review is missing
services/greenfield-worker/tests/module-trust-guard.test.ts#requires a recorded permission review before enable

gaps.title: Reaction notification jobs are dead-lettering on database uniqueness errors
gaps.productionImpact: Ten notification.reaction jobs reached DEAD_LETTER with PostgreSQL 23505, most recently 2026-10-02.
gaps.recommendedFix: Make notification aggregation/upsert idempotent, repair/replay affected dead letters, and add an alert.
gaps.verification: Repeated reactions must converge to one notification and leave no dead letter.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-worker/tests/phase7e.notifications.test.ts#uses the supplied lifecycle identity to dedupe retried follow notifications
services/greenfield-worker/tests/phase7e.notifications.test.ts#reuses the permanent reaction identity when the active dedupe row is older than the aggregate window
services/greenfield-worker/tests/phase7e.notifications.test.ts#is retry-safe and converges concurrent reaction jobs on canonical reaction state

gaps.title: No operational production model/provider is available
gaps.productionImpact: All real providers/models are unconfigured or disabled; the sole available model is a development mock and production has zero executions.
gaps.recommendedFix: Configure and verify a governed real/local provider, then run safe production acceptance through the gateway.
gaps.verification: A non-mock production request must execute, ledger usage, and pass failure/timeout tests.

gaps.title: GAIA is an acceptance-fixture planner, not a general operational planner
gaps.productionImpact: Only four exact fixture objectives are recognized and production has zero mission/decision/ledger rows.
gaps.recommendedFix: Introduce a provider-backed or local Nodus planner behind the existing governed proposal contract without bypassing AKI.
gaps.verification: Unseen objectives must yield bounded proposals and every run must traverse decisions, approvals and ledger.

gaps.title: No Nodus integration surface or local-client contract exists
gaps.productionImpact: Native/offline Nodus has no declared handshake, capability discovery, proposal submission or synchronization contract.
gaps.recommendedFix: Define a local-first Nodus adapter/API boundary using intelligence contracts; do not model Nodus as a cloud provider.
gaps.verification: Contract tests must cover offline proposal, reconnect, approval and ledger synchronization.

gaps.title: Legacy remote function invocation trusts a client-supplied installation ID
gaps.productionImpact: Any authenticated account can nominate another installation ID; the service checks only that installation capability, not installation ownership. Production has two remoteHttp functions but zero active function:invoke grants, so no currently executable production path was proven.
gaps.recommendedFix: Require the installation to belong to the authenticated account and route through the canonical installation/runtime permission service; deprecate the legacy invoke route.
gaps.verification: Two-account integration test must reject B invoking through A installation; an enabled owned grant must still execute through SSRF policy.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-api/tests/api-baseline-02.security-acceptance.test.ts#hides foreign installations on legacy function invocation

gaps.title: AI stream cancel and reconnect omit account ownership checks
gaps.productionImpact: The routes authenticate but pass only streamId; repository loads the stream without account scope. Production has zero stream rows, so active cross-account impact was not exercised.
gaps.recommendedFix: Pass auth.accountId into streaming operations and query/update by stream plus account; return uniform not-found to other users.
gaps.verification: Two-account test must prove B cannot observe, cancel or reconnect A stream.

remediation.status: FIXED — AUTOMATED REGRESSION PASS; PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE PENDING
evidence: services/greenfield-api/tests/api-baseline-02.security-acceptance.test.ts#hides foreign AI streams on reconnect and cancel

gaps.title: Link and poll composer contracts are not persisted by GreenField
gaps.productionImpact: The client has link/poll concepts; the server input has neither. A linkPreview field can be ignored while a text post succeeds.
gaps.recommendedFix: Either remove/disable the controls at the API boundary or implement explicit validated link and poll persistence/contracts.
gaps.verification: Contract tests must prove each advertised composer type survives create and retrieval.

gaps.title: Legacy post image limit is incompatible with nginx public body limit
gaps.productionImpact: GreenField accepts up to 20 MiB of legacy image bytes, but nginx rejects the base64 request above 1 MiB before Fastify.
gaps.recommendedFix: Retire legacy inline media in favor of attachment upload, or align a narrowly scoped edge limit.
gaps.verification: A boundary-size audit attachment must publish through the intended path without widening unrelated routes.

gaps.title: User media exists only on one host bind mount
gaps.productionImpact: Container recreation preserves the bind, but host loss has no discovered object replication or storage readiness/recovery contract.
gaps.recommendedFix: Define backed-up object storage or a tested media backup/restore policy and expose storage readiness internally.
gaps.verification: Restore media plus metadata to a clean host and digest-check every referenced object.

gaps.title: Automated registry/GitHub ingestion is disabled and has no production source
gaps.productionImpact: Ingestion code exists, but production automation is disabled, source count is zero, and the two historical runs cannot recur automatically.
gaps.recommendedFix: Configure a reviewed source and exercise repository-to-published-release convergence with signature/artifact gates.
gaps.verification: A tagged release must be discovered, verified, ingested and published without manual database work.

gaps.title: No application route registers a Fastify request or response schema
gaps.productionImpact: All 446 routes rely on ad hoc handler/service validation; derived OpenAPI cannot describe request/response bodies.
gaps.recommendedFix: Adopt shared schemas incrementally at trust-boundary and mutating routes, then generate canonical OpenAPI.
gaps.verification: Runtime route capture must report schemas for prioritized routes and OpenAPI validation must pass.

gaps.title: Attachment orphan cleanup exists but is never scheduled
gaps.productionImpact: Five ready attachments are unbound; only tests invoke cleanup.
gaps.recommendedFix: Add a bounded worker/ops job with retention, metrics and dry-run visibility.
gaps.verification: Expired sessions/orphans must be removed while bound media remains retrievable.

gaps.title: Story upload validates labels but not decoded size or file signature
gaps.productionImpact: Arbitrary base64 bytes can be stored under an image/video content type; expiration/deletion leaves files on disk.
gaps.recommendedFix: Reuse AttachmentPolicy byte/count/signature validation and add physical cleanup.
gaps.verification: Invalid magic bytes and oversized decoded payloads must fail; expired bytes must be removed.

gaps.title: Profile media has competing canonical-attachment and arbitrary-URL paths
gaps.productionImpact: PATCH can bypass profile_media ownership/binding with an arbitrary public HTTPS URL, producing two ownership/delivery models.
gaps.recommendedFix: Deprecate raw avatarUri/coverUri writes and require owned attachment bindings.
gaps.verification: All new avatar/cover writes must create profile_media and resolve to canonical attachment URLs.

gaps.title: Unknown feed modes silently receive a mislabeled fallback
gaps.productionImpact: Typos or unsupported modes do not fail validation and are labeled modules-chrono-v1.
gaps.recommendedFix: Validate the FeedMode enum before querying.
gaps.verification: Unknown mode must return VALIDATION_FAILED; three supported modes need response snapshots.

gaps.title: Attachment authorization distinguishes private existing IDs from unknown IDs
gaps.productionImpact: An unauthorised existing attachment returns 403 while an unknown ID returns 404, disclosing existence if a UUID is learned.
gaps.recommendedFix: Use a uniform not-found response for unauthorized private media and test timing/shape consistency.
gaps.verification: Cross-user fixture must receive the same status/shape for private-existing and unknown IDs.

gaps.title: Follow, reaction and comment counters have concurrent race windows
gaps.productionImpact: Select-then-insert can surface unique violations, and read-then-set counters can lose increments.
gaps.recommendedFix: Use conflict-safe upserts/row locks or atomic SQL increments and add concurrency tests.
gaps.verification: Parallel duplicate submissions must converge without 500s or counter drift.

gaps.title: Discover/activity surfaces are unpaginated and activity is N+1 hydrated
gaps.productionImpact: Activity reads every active row and resolves profiles in a loop; growth can create unbounded latency.
gaps.recommendedFix: Add stable cursor pagination and batch actor hydration.
gaps.verification: Seeded volume test must show bounded queries and stable cursors.

gaps.title: No persistent real-time social or push delivery surface exists
gaps.productionImpact: The sole SSE path replays AI events; nginx has no WebSocket upgrade and no APNs/web-push subscription API was found.
gaps.recommendedFix: Define polling guarantees or add governed SSE/push subscription infrastructure.
gaps.verification: A client must receive a new notification through the documented mechanism with reconnect semantics.

gaps.title: Connector metadata advertises webhooks without inbound webhook routes
gaps.productionImpact: Provider definitions claim webhook support, but only the module-backend Modula webhook route exists.
gaps.recommendedFix: Mark providers unimplemented or add signed, replay-safe, idempotent provider ingress.
gaps.verification: Each advertised webhook provider must have a verified route and replay test.

gaps.title: Several accepted worker job types complete with no side effect
gaps.productionImpact: Lifecycle event-like jobs, module.settings.migrate and audit.checkpoint are marked succeeded after a no-op.
gaps.recommendedFix: Stop enqueueing event names as jobs or implement explicit consumers and audit checkpoint behavior.
gaps.verification: Every supported job type must have an asserted effect or be rejected as unsupported.

gaps.title: Vault Notes remains special-cased outside the generic host
gaps.productionImpact: Generic MPS hosting works, but search, governed actions, AI actions, Board and presentation logic contain product-specific branches.
gaps.recommendedFix: Move behaviors into manifest/schema/action/projector declarations and retain only generic adapters.
gaps.verification: A neutral reference module must exercise the same flows without core code changes.

gaps.title: Only 6 of 36 historical install plans carry the current descriptor
gaps.productionImpact: Current descriptors are complete, but historical plans cannot be audited through the same immutable contract.
gaps.recommendedFix: Backfill descriptors where release facts are sufficient or explicitly version legacy plans.
gaps.verification: Every active installation must resolve a digest-verified descriptor.

gaps.title: profile_links is read but has no current write API
gaps.productionImpact: The table participates in serialization, but profile update writes only the single website fields on profiles.
gaps.recommendedFix: Define link CRUD or retire/migrate the table.
gaps.verification: Create/update/delete a link and verify privacy-filtered retrieval.

gaps.title: Legacy and canonical media/social/auth paths overlap
gaps.productionImpact: Multiple upload, session and reaction/like paths increase contract drift and already differ at the edge.
gaps.recommendedFix: Declare canonical routes, instrument callers, and deprecate aliases with compatibility windows.
gaps.verification: All clients use canonical routes; aliases have explicit sunset tests.

gaps.title: Request IDs do not provide complete nginx-to-worker tracing
gaps.productionImpact: API/worker use structured logs and database trace fields, but nginx does not preserve the generated response ID into a shared trace and no metrics/tracing backend was discovered.
gaps.recommendedFix: Propagate trace/correlation IDs into jobs and edge logs; export queue/dead-letter/error metrics.
gaps.verification: One synthetic request must be traceable across edge, API, outbox, job and result.

gaps.title: Worker container has no Docker healthcheck
gaps.productionImpact: The new DB heartbeat makes status observable, but Docker cannot independently mark the worker unhealthy.
gaps.recommendedFix: Add a non-invasive healthcheck based on process/heartbeat freshness.
gaps.verification: Stopping worker progress must transition container/status health within the documented window.

gaps.title: 75 application routes have no statically matched automated test
gaps.productionImpact: The route families remain regression-prone; the per-route list is in api-atlas.json.
gaps.recommendedFix: Prioritize authz, mutations, admin/service ingress and feature-gated routes.
gaps.verification: Atlas automatedTest coverage should reach the agreed threshold with security routes at 100%.

gaps.title: All module presentation assets are marked development-only
gaps.productionImpact: Even retrievable Product Hub artwork is explicitly placeholder/development media.
gaps.recommendedFix: Publish production artwork with provenance and remove the development flag.
gaps.verification: Public catalogue must contain no developmentAsset=true for released products.

gaps.title: Legacy canonical backend verifier is pinned to schema 055
gaps.productionImpact: The umbrella verifier requires schema 055 and exact clean main, while observed production is validly at 073_backup_sequence_acl_defaults; it cannot truthfully serve as the current acceptance command.
gaps.recommendedFix: Update the verifier to derive the current migration ledger and separate source, audit-branch, web and production convergence gates.
gaps.verification: The canonical verifier must pass on reviewed current main at 073_backup_sequence_acl_defaults without weakening exact-SHA production checks.

gaps.title: 14 tables have no API/worker source reference
gaps.productionImpact: The static scan identifies legacy, verifier-only or incomplete surfaces that need explicit ownership; it does not prove they are safe to drop.
gaps.recommendedFix: Assign a disposition to each candidate before any cleanup migration.
gaps.verification: Repository-wide reference and production usage review resolves every candidate.

gaps.title: Multiple old verification/recovery PostgreSQL containers remain running
gaps.productionImpact: Old test/recovery databases consume resources and complicate topology, though they are excluded from production truth.
gaps.recommendedFix: Inventory owners and retire only after backup/recovery confirmation.
gaps.verification: Only documented production and active audit containers remain.

gaps.title: Redis is running without persistence and has no application source references
gaps.productionImpact: Redis adds operational surface but GreenField uses PostgreSQL queues and no Redis client reference was found.
gaps.recommendedFix: Remove it from the GreenField stack if truly unused, or document and monitor its intended role.
gaps.verification: Dependency graph either names a real Redis consumer or the service is absent.

gaps.title: Route-to-table and caller mappings are static approximations
gaps.productionImpact: Dynamic dispatch, SQL helpers and client-computed paths can evade the extractor; confidence is recorded per route.
gaps.recommendedFix: Add runtime SQL tracing in a disposable test harness and typed client instrumentation.
gaps.verification: Representative flows reconcile static maps with observed queries without production tracing.
